title: Align Agent Runtime core with the opaque candidate-text contract

purpose: Replace the superseded syntax-rejection delta from failed TASK-028 with the owner-approved opaque untrusted text contract while preserving and re-proving the existing authorized FT-007 W1 runtime core.

anti_goals: No Markdown, HTML, prompt, instruction, command, or URL grammar, parser, sanitizer, filter, renderer, or active-link behavior.
No Bus/UI literal-rendering implementation, classifier policy/effect, Safety/task/action effect, or FT-008/FT-011/FT-012 work.
No provider/model configuration, roster/bootstrap hook, real-provider dependency, or credentialed smoke work.
No rewrite of TASK-028 history, verification evidence, retry budget, or BUG origin evidence.
No broader Agent Runtime, Plant Operations, API, Timeline, or frontend refactor without direct canonical evidence and explicit re-planning.

markup/prompt recognizers, sanitizers, renderers, or active links

stop_conditions: TASK-025-T3-FT-004-W3 is not done or its canonical Plant-operation baseline is contradicted.
The canonical opaque-text contract conflicts with another direct task-linked authoritative spec.
Correctness requires writes outside contracts.py and test_ft007_runtime.py; stop and record the exact canonical evidence before any owner-approved scope widening.
The change would interpret candidate text as instructions or give it classification, routing, publication, task, Safety, approval, or action authority.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, session/auth material, raw provider payload, prompt history, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or local absolute paths.

constraints: Treat candidate_output as opaque untrusted normalized text: accept schema-valid 1..2000-code-point formatting-looking values unchanged and do not parse, filter, sanitize, or classify them by syntax.

Remove only the superseded syntax/prompt regex rejection while preserving strict AgentModelResultV1, MessageEnvelopeV1, ProviderRequestV1, runtime-outcome, classifier-handoff, ref, confidence, and unknown-field matrices.
Preserve the existing current authorization guard, immutable pending/non-consumable envelope, sanitized audit, audit-failure, archive/revoke, and no-replay behavior.
Keep candidate text out of all instruction/control channels and give authority only to typed project-owned classifier/guards/Safety/human decisions.
Keep execution writes narrow to contracts.py, test_ft007_runtime.py, and task-owned protocol/evidence unless canonical evidence proves a necessary widening and the owner re-plans it.
invariants: Model text is data, never runtime, classifier, publication, task, Safety, approval, or action authority.
Agno/provider output never overrides project schemas, authorization, PostgreSQL authority, current guards, or sanitized audit rules.
Only strict model-declared silence is silent; invalid, failed, denied, guard-blocked, or audit-failed branches create no MessageEnvelope or replayable candidate.
Every accepted non-silent MessageEnvelope remains pending_classification and consumable_by_agents=false.
FT-007 creates no Bus/UI/task/Safety effect and does not implement literal rendering or typed Bus quotation.
verification_targets: Probe representative Markdown, HTML, prompt, instruction, command, and URL-looking strings for byte-for-byte/code-point-preserving AgentModelResultV1-to-MessageEnvelopeV1 handoff and zero authority side effects.
Inspect the scoped production diff for residual syntax/prompt rejection and for any new renderer, parser, command, routing, classification, publication, or action path.
